meta.approval: User selected Generate Terraform from this plan; network_address_space=10.88.0.0/16. Code and local configuration only, no deployment.

inputs.userGoal: Adapt the demo for policy-compliant private networking with a new private setup runner.
subGoals: Keep Blob public access disabled; use Entra ID and managed identity without credentials.
Preserve the native Copilot Studio connection and existing Task targets.
Generate Terraform only under src/foundryiq; the user runs all provisioning.

properties.naming: Existing random_pet + random_id decimal suffix convention

reasoning.whyChosen: Keep all demo resources in the existing disposable scope.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Container Apps also creates a managed infrastructure resource group; deleting the parent environment must clean it up.

reasoning.whyChosen: Align desired state with the enforced private-Storage policy.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Uploads require the private runner; local browsers cannot follow Blob citations without network access.

reasoning.whyChosen: S2 supports managed private Blob ingestion; keyless public Search ingress preserves Copilot Studio connectivity.
reasoning.tradeoffs: S2 costs more than Basic. Tier migration may replace Search; review the Terraform plan.

properties.projectAndModels: Retain the existing project -> chat -> embedding dependency chain.

reasoning.whyChosen: Keep the approved, deployed Foundry account and models.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Foundry remains keyless-public; this is not an all-services-private architecture.

properties.subnets: Two non-overlapping /27 subnets derived from the configured VNet CIDR.

reasoning.whyChosen: A self-contained private upload path without assuming existing VPN or peering.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No VPN, peering, custom DNS forwarding, or enterprise hub integration is included.

reasoning.whyChosen: Required for explicit outbound Internet access from the private runner subnet.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Incurs an additional public IP charge; it is not an inbound endpoint for the job.

reasoning.whyChosen: Explicit egress for image pull, Entra sign-in, and public Search/Foundry APIs.
reasoning.tradeoffs: NAT adds fixed cost and does not filter destinations; enterprise egress inspection is out of scope.

reasoning.whyChosen: Dedicated delegated subnet for a workload-profiles environment.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Consumption-only does not provide the required NAT Gateway integration.

reasoning.whyChosen: Private endpoints cannot share the delegated runner subnet.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Uses a separate small subnet in the isolated demo VNet.

reasoning.whyChosen: Resolve the ordinary Blob hostname to the private endpoint inside the runner VNet.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The fixed service DNS zone name is a platform requirement, unlike generated resource names.

reasoning.whyChosen: Give the VNet-integrated uploader a private path to Storage.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Separate from Search's managed shared private link; both are required.

properties.approval: Approve only the target connection with this demo's unique request message; wait for Approved/Succeeded.

reasoning.whyChosen: Search ingestion runs in the Search-managed execution network, not the upload VNet.
alternativesConsidered: Only create a customer-VNet private endpoint
reasoning.tradeoffs: Requires target-side approval in addition to managed-identity Blob permissions.

reasoning.whyChosen: Stable, credential-free identity for every manual setup execution.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Separate workload and operator role assignments are required.

properties.operator: Azure CLI token oid, not Terraform's deployer identity
properties.runner: Blob Data Contributor, Search Service Contributor, Search Index Data Contributor, existing Foundry user/project roles
properties.search: Storage Blob Data Reader and existing model role

reasoning.whyChosen: Separate deployment, operator, Search, project, and setup identities.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The operator must also have permission to approve this demo's pending Storage private endpoint connection.

properties.logs: Authenticated job console logs; no persistent analytics workspace

reasoning.whyChosen: VNet-integrated job hosting with explicit NAT support.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No HA, persistent log archive, custom image registry, or enterprise firewall; synthetic disposable demo only.

properties.secrets: None; start receives only public sample code, synthetic policies, and non-secret configuration

reasoning.whyChosen: A finite manual execution with cloud-reported success/failure, without assuming local VNet access.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Task setup must wait for the actual execution, show console errors, reject overlapping executions, and fail on failed or timed-out jobs.

overallReasoning.summary: Keep the existing Foundry and Copilot Studio design. Move upload/configuration into an on-demand managed-identity job, provide a private Blob endpoint and DNS for that job, and use an independently approved Search shared private link with private managed ingestion.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: User approved S2 and a new private runner. No deployment, policy exemption, deletion, or change outside src/foundryiq is authorized. Use repository suffix naming instead of generic CAF prefixes. The insights_get tool was unavailable; scoped read-only CLI checks established the actual failure. Search WAF service guidance was unavailable; canonical connector/networking documentation was used. Long-term diagnostics, HA, redundancy beyond LRS, CMK, NSP, egress filtering, and all-services-private ingress are intentionally excluded. Regional capacity remains unproven until the user provisions.

plan.validation: Check dependency graph, CIDR/subnet pairing, supported S2 private ingestion, workload-profiles NAT integration, generated-name constraints, least-privilege identity boundaries, offline Terraform schema, and mocked job/approval failure paths. Do not claim a live private deployment has been verified.
